name: cake-heal-window
comment: WP-4.6. BlockCake.eatCakeSlice heals through EntityLiving.heal (EntityLiving.java:296-305), which also sets heartsLife = heartsHalvesLife / 2 = 10 and so shortens the damage-resistance window. The player (id 0) on stone with a cake at (2, 61, 2). t=2 a hit of 6 with no attacker (attack op, direct): health 14, heartsLife 20. t=4 use_item on the cake: health 17, meta 1, heartsLife 10. t=5 a hit of 4: heartsLife (9 after a tick) is not above 10, so the full 4 counts (health 13); without the heartsLife write it would still be 16 > 10 and only damage above the window's 6 would count (none). t=12 a hit of 3 inside the new window (heartsLife about 13): only 3 - 4 < 0, nothing. t=14 eat again: heartsLife 10 again; t=15 a hit of 2 counts fully. t=30 eat at 17 or so; difficulty 0 regeneration (EntityPlayer.onLivingUpdate, every 20 ticks, also through heal) runs at t = 19 and 39. entity_state of the player, player_state and the cake every tick.
